bio: Boscundle Manor offers old country house charm coupled with uniquely interesting art and striking décor a short walk from the Eden Project and the stunning Carlyon Bay.  A hidden gem on the outskirts of Carlyon Bay and St Austell, a former mine Captains abode the recent renovation makes the historical building sing. Reserved for over 12s, guests are promised a relaxing afternoon in Manor’s library or basking in the sun on one of the hotel’s three terraces in the beautiful landscape grounds.  Afternoon Tea at the Manor is handcrafted by the onsite bakery Manor Made Cornwall: offering a unique take on the traditional afternoon tea.  Savoury delights include sausage rolls, freshly baked open sandwich, soupette & quiches. For a sweet craving you will enjoy award winning caramel shortbread, pavlova, financiers and possets.  No Afternoon Tea is complete without the Manor’s famous scones, clotted cream and jam – and in Cornwall it is always jam first!
